name: Ọ̀ṣun (Yoruba)

domain_history.domain: river deity, wealth, power, and femininity, principal shrine at Òṣogbo

notes: Diedre L. Badejo, Ọ̀ṣun Ṣèègèsí: The Elegant Deity of Wealth, Power, and Femininity (Africa World Press, 1996) — described as the first full-length original research study of a major Yorùbá goddess, based on fieldwork at Òṣogbo, tracing her presence across West Africa, Cuba, Brazil, and the US.
